framing: Buildout scenarios (multiples of today's effective IT MW), not forecasts. TOTAL is Scope 1+2+3 (~87% off-site Scope 2); ON-SITE is Scope 1 only (the ICPRB-comparable quantity).

icprb_cross_check_onsite.note: ICPRB forecasts ON-SITE (Scope 1) consumptive use for the whole Washington Metro Area; PWC is a subset. Only our Scope 1 is comparable -- our TOTAL is ~87% Scope 2 (off-site power-plant water) that ICPRB's on-site number excludes. That our on-site is a fraction of the WMA total, while our total dwarfs it, IS the displacement thesis.

headline: Today ~50 MGD total (1.8 MGD on-site). The committed ~1970 MW pipeline lifts the total to ~61 MGD by 2030-31. By 2050 the total spans ~61 (pipeline only) to ~145 MGD (3x buildout) on today's grid -- but DECARBONIZING the grid cuts the central case from ~97 to ~45 MGD, a bigger lever than any facility measure because Scope 2 dominates. On-site Scope 1 rises to ~4 MGD, still a fraction of ICPRB's ~22 MGD WMA-wide on-site forecast (consistent).
